summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #39 (adopt generated OpenAPI client + solver parity corpus). Committed 5 test files and 2 docs. SolverParityCorpusTests and OpenAPIDocumentContractTests are intentionally red: the upstream artifacts (viamin/color_matching#110 spec, #111 corpus) are not published (GitHub returns 404) and the implementation run must commit ColorComposerCore/OpenAPI/openapi.json and ColorComposerCore/ParityCorpus/solver_parity_corpus.json. No Swift toolchain exists in this container ('swift: command not found'; bin/lint self-skips), so no tests could be executed here; macOS CI or a Swift host must run `swift test`. PaletteAPIClientContractTests and PaletteFetchCacheRoundTripTests are the green-net pinning the behavior the generated-client migration must preserve.
